about: Default backdrops (dungeon/art.py backdrop): pictures of generic places, shown behind the story when nobody has made a picture of the place. Made once with scripts/art/backdrops.py (Windows/backdrops.bat); the images are assets/backdrops/<id>.webp, and <id>-night.webp for an outdoor one. A backdrop is picked by a place's own `backdrop`, then a hex site or terrain, a blank lot's entry, the most shared tags, the kind, the street, the default. Faction emblems (`emblems`, by faction id, in `emblem_style`) and item icons (`icons`: by item id, the ids in `items`, or a whole `category`, in `icon_style`) are made by scripts/art/icons.py into assets/emblems and assets/icons (dungeon/icons.py).
backdrop_style: Photorealistic 35mm photograph, natural light, autumn 2009 in a small upstate New York college town, period-accurate details (no smartphones, 2000s cars and signage), wide establishing shot
backdrop_avoid: people, figures, text, lettering, signs with words, watermark, logo

keyart.prompt: Key art for a modern fantasy university drama. Golden hour in late October 2009 on a gothic-revival stone college quad on a hill above a long Finger Lakes lake; a clock tower, ivy gone red, maples shedding orange leaves over brick paths; faint violet light glowing up through the cracks of three crossing paths like buried lines of power; one lone student with a backpack walking away from the camera, small in frame. Warm, melancholy, a little uncanny. Open sky in the upper left third.
keyart.avoid: text, lettering, words, title, logo, watermark, readable interface text

emblem_style: An emblem for an organization in a 2009 American college town where magic is regulated by law: a crisp seal, crest, patch or logo mark, clean flat design with a subtle print texture, centered and filling the frame, on a transparent background
emblem_avoid: text, letters, numbers, words, readable labels, brand logos, watermark, signature, background scene, frame border, people, hands
